name: L10N4-insession-keeps-dropped-keys
old: for (const key of [...rows.keys()]) if (!en.has(key)) { rows.delete(key); delete nextMeta[key]; report.dropped.push(`${code} ${key}`); }

name: L10N4-insession-records-as-a-person
old: nextMeta[key] = { en: hash(en.get(key)), tr: hash(text), by: IN_SESSION };
new: nextMeta[key] = { en: hash(en.get(key)), tr: hash(text), by: 'human' };

name: L10N4-insession-unknown-key-written
old: if (!en.has(key)) { report.refused.push(`${code} ${key}: not in the English catalog`); continue; }
